answer: The forge test I would run is proof of unique surveyor chartered status with royal institution attestation: a chartered status the institution granted after assessed practice, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the beacon of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head. The knoll is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
